_comment.about: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. Standard JSON does not support // comments, so these _comment fields provide explanations and are ignored by Pi-Dash. All optional settings have code defaults; deleting a setting does not require replacing it with another one.
_comment.base_path: Default: /. Set a URL path such as /pi-dash/ when hosting behind a reverse proxy. The proxy must forward this prefix consistently.
_comment.refresh_interval: Default: 5000 milliseconds. Refreshes the main statistics. The example recommends 2000 ms; existing configurations retain their configured value.
_comment.queries_refresh_interval: Default: the effective refresh_interval. Separately controls the optional live-query feed. The example recommends 3000 ms. Omitting this key preserves the old query cadence.
_comment.cache_ttl: Default: min(1000, max(100, min(refresh_interval, queries_refresh_interval) / 2)) milliseconds, rounded down. The example uses 1000 ms. Set 0 to disable the shared in-process cache. An explicit cache TTL may delay fresh upstream data; keep it below your fastest polling interval.
_comment.show_queries: Default: false. Enables the optional DNS query feed. Queries are requested only while the browser page is visible and online; hidden/offline pages stop polling. Desktop uses the original ambient background feed; compact mobile/landscape layouts use a collapsible panel below the cards.
_comment.show_network_summary: Default: true. Shows additive DNS totals across reporting Pi-holes. If an instance is unavailable, totals are marked partial. Active clients and unique domains are not summed because they can overlap.
_comment.show_trends: Default: true. Shows a short query-rate sparkline kept only in browser memory. It does not create a database or store historical DNS activity.
_comment.piholes: Default: empty list. Add one or more Pi-hole instances below. Names must be unique. Every enabled instance needs a name and address.

_comment.name: Required. Unique display name for this Pi-hole.
_comment.address: Required. Full Pi-hole base URL, including http:// or https:// and any port. Do not include /admin or /api. Example: http://192.168.1.50:80.
_comment.password: Default: empty string. Use an API/application password or ${ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE}. A literal password is supported for existing installations. An unset environment variable is not silently replaced with an empty password.
_comment.enabled: Default: true. Set false to exclude this Pi-hole without deleting its configuration.
_comment.link: Default: false. If true, the instance name opens its Pi-hole administration page in a new tab.
_comment.verify_ssl: Default: false for compatibility with existing self-signed LAN installations. Set true for a trusted HTTPS certificate, or provide a path to a CA bundle, including ${ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE}. This controls the Pi-Dash-to-Pi-hole connection.
